data.cultural_impact: The name Lira has origins in ancient Rome and Greece, where the lyre was an important musical instrument. Naming a child Lira evokes a sense of creativity, artistic expression, and connection to the classical world.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian symbolism, the lyre or harp is an instrument of divine inspiration and is often associated with the Biblical King David, who was a renowned harpist and a man after God's own heart. The name Lira carries a spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of using our God-given talents to create beautiful music and bring joy to the world. This resonates with the Bible verse, Romans 15:9, which says "And may God himself, the God who makes peace, sanctify you completely; and may your whole spirit and soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ." By carrying the name Lira, one may be inspired to live a life filled with love, creativity, and spiritual growth.
